remaining: SWIEPH and Moshier are different numerical backends sharing the Swiss Ephemeris software family, not wholly independent astronomical observations.
Numerical term-root precision cannot establish the absolute second of an original Chinese solar-term event; UT1/UTC and ΔT assumptions remain.
At the fictional fixed UTC+8 2057-08-07 07:34:09, both calendar libraries assign the next month while SWIEPH apparent Sun has not yet crossed 135 degrees.
The thirty-six clocks were deliberately chosen near source term boundaries and are not population samples.
Traditional BaZi time policies, exact solar-time geography, hidden-star interpretation, human questionnaires and blind evaluation remain open.
